title: Sales Executive
summary: Front-line sales role representing our partner brands to B2B and B2C customers. No prior experience required — full training provided.
duties: Engage prospective customers through face-to-face and outbound campaigns
Present partner products and services with clarity and integrity
Meet and exceed weekly performance targets
Maintain accurate records of leads and outcomes
Participate in daily coaching and team huddles
requirements: Willingness to learn — no sales experience required

title: Sales Team Leader
summary: Lead a team of sales executives — coaching daily performance, running campaigns, and developing the next generation of leaders.
duties: Lead, coach, and motivate a team of 4–8 sales executives
Run morning huddles and daily field coaching
Track team KPIs and report performance to management
Support recruitment and onboarding of new team members
Own campaign execution for assigned partner accounts
requirements: 1+ year of direct sales or team leadership experience
Proven track record of hitting performance targets
perks: Leadership bonus structure on top of commissions

title: Corporate Sales Consultant
summary: Manage B2B relationships — helping businesses adopt our partners' electricity, printing, and service solutions.
duties: Prospect and qualify B2B leads across assigned industries
Conduct consultative meetings with business decision-makers
Prepare proposals and close corporate accounts
Coordinate handover with partner providers
Maintain long-term client relationships for repeat business
requirements: 2+ years in B2B sales or account management
Comfortable presenting to business owners and managers
perks: Higher-value commission tiers on corporate accounts

title: Marketing Associate
summary: Support campaign marketing — content, social media, and lead-generation assets that fuel the sales teams.
duties: Create content for social media and recruitment campaigns
Support lead-generation asset production
Track and report campaign engagement metrics
Coordinate with sales teams on campaign materials
Assist with events and team-building documentation
requirements: Portfolio of content or social media work (student projects welcome)
Working knowledge of Canva, CapCut, or similar tools
